exclusion_rebind.current_inference_authorization: explicit user authorization for this frozen evaluation

prompt.system_message: Select the best answer. Reply with exactly one uppercase option letter and no explanation.
prompt.candidate_labels: Uppercase A, B, ... in canonical source option order; labels are appended directly after the chat template's assistant prefix.
prompt.candidate_label_tokenization: For every item and every valid choice, tokenize prompt and prompt+label; require prompt tokens to remain an exact prefix and exactly one additional token. Require candidate token IDs to be unique within the item.
prompt.context_line: Always keep the Context line, including for an empty context.
prompt.choice_order: Keep canonical source order; do not shuffle, relabel, or permute the options themselves.
prompt.comparison_note: Same context, question, option text, and source order; chat wrapper, letter labels, answer instruction, and LM-head readout differ from the trained numeric-choice decision-head prompt. This is an end-to-end comparison, not a pure backbone ablation.

inference.kind: single-token candidate-label likelihood from the original causal-LM output head

scoring.probabilities: Softmax over the valid candidate-letter logits only; these are restricted-choice probabilities, not full-vocabulary probabilities.
scoring.negative_log_likelihood: Mean -log(p_gold) for the one-hot gold choice under the restricted candidate-label distribution.
scoring.multiclass_brier_score: Mean sum_j((p_j - y_j)^2) over valid choices, where y is one-hot gold.
scoring.uniform_baseline: Per-item expected accuracy 1/K, NLL log(K), and multiclass Brier score 1 - 1/K; aggregate by the same source slices and diagnostic strata.

exploratory_diagnostics.cross_tabs: source_slice x choice_count_bin x input_token_bin; source_slice x exact_choice_count x input_token_bin
exploratory_diagnostics.token_count_definition: Actual tokenizer input length for the full no-thinking chat prompt before the candidate label continuation.
exploratory_diagnostics.reuse_label: Exploratory reused-test diagnostics; descriptive only and unavailable for model, training, prompt, or checkpoint selection.

resumption.cursor: Canonical file ordinal; aggregate sufficient statistics by source, choice-count bin, token-count bin, and declared cross-tabs only.
resumption.unclean_interruption: If an in-flight item marker remains, stop as indeterminate and do not replay it.
resumption.normal_stop: Pause only after the current item has committed; resume from the next ordinal.

comparison_limit: A comparison with the trained decision head is end-to-end because prompt wrappers, choice labels, and readout layers differ. It does not isolate the effect of training the backbone or prove absence of pretraining contamination.

suite_reuse.comparison_note: The suite has prior inference reuse. This baseline is a new fixed original-model method; no test outcome may change its prompt or scoring. Compare aggregates as exploratory end-to-end results only.

contamination_limit: The current lock reports zero excluded identifiers/groups; no fresh exact/lexical audit was run against the current training snapshot. Semantic overlap and pretrained-model exposure are unknown.
